proposed_english: year of failure / year of scarcity
rationale: Compound on ⲣⲙ̄ⲡⲉ ('year') + ϣⲉⲗⲣⲉ (root unclear; possibly ϣⲗⲟ 'fail, be exhausted' or related to a seasonal-deficiency root). Context: a diminishing of waters and crops happens 'of a ⲣⲙ̄ⲡϣⲉⲗⲣⲉ.' The agricultural-zodiacal frame (paired with diminishing of fruits, figs, water) supports a famine/scarcity sense. Confidence low; flagged for parallels in subsequent kephalaia.
Greek σκορπίος; the zodiac sign Scorpio. First of three water-element signs (with Pisces and Cancer).
Greek ἰχθύς 'fish'; the zodiac sign Pisces. Standard astrological term.
Greek καρκίνος 'crab'; the zodiac sign Cancer. Standard astrological term.
Greek Δίδυμος 'twin'; Lycopolitan ⲇⲓⲁⲩⲙⲟⲥ for Δίδυμος. The zodiac sign Gemini, first of the three air signs.
Greek ζυγός 'yoke, balance'; the zodiac sign Libra. Standard astrological term.
Greek ὑδροχόος 'water-pourer'; the zodiac sign Aquarius. Standard astrological term, third of the air signs.

Greek ἀναβιβάζων 'ascending one' — astronomical-astrological term for the ascending lunar node (Caput Draconis). The pair (ⲥⲛⲉⲩ 'two') refers to both the ascending and descending nodes — the 'dragon's head and tail.' Retained as Greek technical term.

ⲡⲉⲧ- relative + ϣⲟⲩⲱⲩ 'be dry' — qualitative substantival 'the dry one.' Cosmic principle paired with ⲡⲉⲧⲁⲩⲃⲉ 'the Moist one' as Father/Mother of the cosmos. Direct elemental-correspondential identification.
Lycopolitan ⲍⲱⲃ = ϩⲱⲃ 'work, matter, business' (cf. accumulated ⲡⲍⲱⲃ in earlier kephalaia). Used here for the cosmic refining-work that draws light upon sun and moon.

proposed_english: to be seated downward / sit down
rationale: Lycopolitan compound: ⲍⲙⲉⲥⲧ (qualitative of ϩⲙⲟⲟⲥ 'sit') + ⲁⲡⲓⲧⲛ̄ ('downward'). Idiom for 'sit down, be seated.' Standard narrative-frame opener for Mani's discourses.
